description: Mixed flat and scoped ADR archive with explicit applicability, local house format and a higher nested ID.

files.docs/agents/layout.md:
# Layout

Approved Areas: atlas (Topics ingest and export), beacon (zero Topics).
ADRs are kept directly in docs/adr/ under the existing flat convention.
files.docs/adr/README.md:
# Decisions

House format: title, Status, Area, optional Topic, Decision. No frontmatter. Accepted decisions are immutable; supersession uses a new global ADR ID. Filenames use NNNN-slug.md.

- [ADR-0003 Shared retention](0003-retention.md): atlas and beacon.
- [ADR-0005 Atlas boundary](0005-boundary.md): atlas, ingest and export.
- [ADR-0007 Intake ownership](0007-intake.md): atlas, ingest.
- [ADR-0012 Intake receipts](atlas/ingest/0012-receipts.md): atlas, ingest.
files.docs/adr/0003-retention.md:
# Shared retention

Status: accepted
Area: atlas, beacon

## Decision

Both Areas retain accepted records for the agreed retention period.
files.docs/adr/0005-boundary.md:
# Atlas boundary

Status: accepted
Area: atlas
Topic: ingest, export

## Decision

Ingest validates incoming records; export owns delivery.
files.docs/adr/0007-intake.md:
# Intake ownership

Status: accepted
Area: atlas
Topic: ingest

## Decision

The ingest Topic owns intake acceptance.
files.docs/adr/atlas/ingest/0012-receipts.md:
# Intake receipts

Status: accepted
Area: atlas
Topic: ingest
